map.分辨率不确定度（本页代码口径，矩形分布）：u=a÷(2×√3)（a 为分辨率全宽: Resolution uncertainty (this page's code basis, rectangular distribution): u = a÷(2×√3) (a the full resolution width, i.e. the half width a÷2 divided by √3); linked values: comparison term = u÷√3, expanded uncertainty U(k=2) = a÷√3, half width back-solved from u = u×2×√3, uncertainty percentage = u×100 (exponential form). Validation: no strict validation; empty values fall back to 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; when a is the digital display resolution, u is the standard uncertainty component introduced by that resolution.
